# Final verification - list all test files and their test counts
import os, re
for fname in sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden')):
    if fname.endswith('.py'):
        with open(f'crucible_hidden/{fname}') as f:
            content = f.read()
        tests = re.findall(r'^def test_\w+', content, re.MULTILINE)
        print(f"{fname}: {len(tests)} tests")
